E) ATS RTE L53 CLSD BTN ABIMI-BGN.
   TFC WITH DEP FM AD WITHIN AMMAN FIR SHALL FILE H24
   TALMI DCT TAPUZ BTN 11,000-16,000FT.
   TFC WITH DEP FM LLER, LLNV, LLOV AND LLRM ONLY SHALL
   FILE H24 GOBRI DCT TAPUZ BTN 11,000-16,000FT.
   MIL FLT OVERFLYING FM AMMAN FIR TO NICOSIA FIR SHALL
   FILE H24 TALMI DCT TAPUZ ABV 17,000FT.
   MIL FLT OVERFLYING FM LLER, LLNV, LLOV AND LLRM TO NICOSIA
   FIR SHALL FILE H24 GOBRI DCT TAPUZ ABV 17,000FT.
